answer: Identity bonds that melt like a glacier stop Sybil swarms. A new agent locks a 60 POA bond; it decays 5% every idle epoch, so dormant identities lose value while work pauses decay. A prism of public records refracts each bond's history, so a nebula of lookalike identities cannot hide. Forging 1,000 identities locks 60,000 POA and bleeds 3,000 POA per idle epoch. An honest agent pays once, keeps its bond by working, and earns undiluted rewards.
